We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We must produce JSON route where each reaction node uses the given template_id (as integer? example shows number). Provide children as precursor molecules (type mol). The final target is the given SMILES.

We need to apply each template sequentially to break down the target into precursors, ending with some simple building blocks (maybe commercially available). We need to generate route using apply_template tool to get precursors for each step.

We already applied template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of tuples). The result format: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C',))"

It seems three possible outcomes: first with silyl protecting group, second without silyl, third maybe a different cleavage.

We need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389.

The next template 1914389 applied to the first precursor gave two products: ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC').

So applying 1914389 to that first precursor gave two possible precursors: one is a molecule still with silyl group, the other is an ester/alkene with phosphonate? Actually second is CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC.

We need to continue with template 1914390 applied to something. We tried applying 1914390 to the first product (the silyl-containing) but got no result. Also applied to the second product (CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC) got no result.

Maybe we need to choose a different branch from earlier step.

Let's examine the second precursor from 29646: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' (no silyl on the side chain? Actually still silyl on carboxylate). We tried applying 1914389 to that and got no result.

Third precursor: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)' which is a simpler molecule lacking the long chain. Maybe that can be processed with 1914389.

Let's try applying 1914389 to third precursor.
